body: GET /api/v1/status/history?target=<name>&hours=<n> — raw per-check history (up/down + latency_ms), capped at 500 samples/168h, backed by statuspage.Store.History over the existing checks table (no schema change, every check already retained). status.html renders it as a colored-bar incident timeline per service, hover for exact time/status/latency. Live-verified through okemily.com's public proxy against real production check history (iduna: 61 real checks/1h). 9 new tests across both packages, go build/vet/test -race clean. Latency-graph-as-chart and a public postmortem log remain open, disclosed not attempted. IDUNA bb83539, OKEMILY 20c6936.
